entries.name: Grimlock
entries: {@i Puppet of the Mind Flayer Menace}

Grimlocks are victims of biological manipulation by mind flayers. To create grimlocks, illithids capture Humanoids, expose them to strange forms of Underdark radiation, and implant new directives into their brains. The process of creating a grimlock rends the creature's mind such that no semblance of the individual's former personality remains.

Grimlocks have shallow depressions rather than eyes. A sixth sense allows grimlocks to perceive their surroundings. Psychic energies from their transformations linger in grimlocks' bodies, and they channel these eerie forces into their attacks.
Roll on or choose a result from the Grimlock Tasks table to inspire how grimlocks serve illithids.

entries.caption: Grimlock Tasks
colLabels: The Grimlock Serves Mind Flayers By...
rows: Carving caves to serve as illithid outposts.
Hiding the threat of mind flayers beneath fake, purposefully crude dwellings.
Pretending to be helpful and luring travelers into false senses of security.
Raiding surface communities and tempting other creatures to pursue it into illithid traps.

entries: We thought we'd discovered a new people living deeper than we believed possible. The truth was something far worse.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The grimlock has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The grimlock has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

trait.name: Blind Senses
entries: The grimlock can't use its blindsight while {@condition deafened} and unable to smell.
